note: NJ-Kit assets v1 (release tag assets-v1): the heavy parts kept out of the git tree. `python nj-kit/scripts/fetch_assets.py --list` shows them; `<name>` or `--all` downloads, verifies sha256 and puts them at `target` (relative to the repo root, or to --root).

assets.name: graphify-package
assets.what: graphify Python package and per-platform skill files (third party; bundled/graphify keeps only skill.md)
assets.licence: Apache-2.0 and MIT (upstream LICENSE files are inside the wheel)
assets.needed_by: graphify (the CLI itself installs with: uv tool install "graphifyy[office]")

assets.name: researcher-sources-db
assets.what: nj-researcher source registry (SQLite, 328 sources). Without network, `python scripts/sources.py seed --reset` rebuilds a registry from data/seed.tsv.

assets.name: tashkeel-evidence-runs
assets.what: Raw model-run evidence for the Arabic tashkeel KB (run1, run1-scored, run2, run3, run5, run6 JSON), read by the analysis scripts in the same folder.
